product_one_liner.value: Fluxco is an AI-assisted transformer procurement marketplace that helps utilities, data centers, renewable-energy developers, and other infrastructure buyers specify equipment and source competitive bids from manufacturers.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes its global transformer marketplace and network of OEMs; the WSJ article describes its AI-assisted buyer platform.

pricing_page.notes: The site homepage/footer lists no pricing page; the public site directs visitors to start a project rather than publishing a pricing page.

named_customers.notes: The closest customer-use report located names Antora Energy, but fewer than two customer names were identifiable; no second customer name was found to support the requested list.

employee_band.notes: Tracxn lists 13 employees as of August 2026, placing Fluxco in the 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: Fluxco's LinkedIn company profile identifies Austin, Texas as its headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Caplight's company profile lists Fluxco as founded in 2025.

eng_blog.notes: The resource index contains customer-facing transformer and procurement explainers, not at least two engineering-authored posts about how Fluxco's product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public FAQ/help center has multiple categorized articles covering ordering, technical specifications, services, and pricing.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers listing includes a Full-Stack Software Engineer (AI-Native Generalist) posting.

model_provider.notes: The privacy policy, terms, FAQ, and AI-focused engineering job posting were checked; although Fluxco mentions AI and AI-assisted outputs, no specific model or provider is publicly named.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy page does not name any of the listed certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS).

last_funding.notes: Caplight lists a $26 million Seed round in July 2026; the WSJ reported the round as led by Congruent Ventures and 8VC.

raised_18mo.notes: The reported $26 million seed round in July 2026 falls within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers page lists Enterprise Account Executive roles, including one serving energy and infrastructure developers.

launched_6mo.notes: A post by Fluxco's founder/CEO titled “Fluxco Launches to Simplify Power Distribution Equipment Access” appeared about three months before the run date, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No sufficiently verifiable dated C-level or VP-level join/departure announcement or complete company team page was found to establish a change or its absence.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable careers listings and sales role posting do not name a CRM or sales/marketing system.
